name: Checkout creates order shows payment settings and accepts proof
description: Verify the complete customer journey from cart to persisted order, live transfer settings, payment proof upload, account history, cart clearing, and stock deduction.

planSteps.description: Navigate home, add Classic Ceramic Mug to cart, then log in as rafi.ahmad@example.com with RafStore#2026 and open checkout.
Fill shipping with recipient TestSprite Checkout, phone 081234567890, address Jalan TestSprite Checkout Nomor 16 Jakarta, city Jakarta, province DKI Jakarta, postal code 12345, then continue.
Verify an order is created, total is Rp109.000, live BCA and Bank Mandiri accounts are visible, and the four transfer instructions are shown.
Continue to confirmation, upload a generated valid small PNG as payment proof, check the transfer confirmation checkbox, and confirm payment.
Verify upload succeeds, Ringkasan opens, a real RAF order number is displayed, and status is waiting for verification.
Verify the new order appears in order history and the cart is empty after checkout.
